summary: Remove the retired catalog DING sidecar transport while preserving current notification renderers

replay.detail: No graph replay or current native delivery path changes. The removed inbox-to-PTY sidecar has no current product entry point after catalog supervisor retirement.

schema.detail: No database schema change. Existing inbox, archive, PTY and runtime files are neither migrated nor deleted.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules, wire contraction, digests or member activation changes.

compatibility.detail: Removes workspace-internal obsolete DING serve/run/poker APIs, terminal-screen classifiers and their now-unused private process helpers. Current bounded notification/envelope formatters, attachment/assistant provenance handling, catalog relationship formatter and accepted durable tag families remain with identical implementations and retained assertions.

downtime.detail: No additional service interruption; active native delivery and terminal ownership paths remain.

manual.detail: No existing installation needs cleanup. Old sidecar state stays on disk; the current graph runtime and compatibility readers remain available.

recovery.detail: No new store recovery or downgrade requirement. Reverting restores source only; persisted state is unchanged.
